newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH POLICE FIND 90,000 LITRES OF SMUGGLED BOOZE.
newsitem.headline: POLISH POLICE FIND 90,000 LITRES OF SMUGGLED BOOZE.

text.p: Polish police discovered nearly 90,000 litres of pure spirit smuggled in from Germany -- the single largest alcohol shipment bust in Poland, PAP news agency said on Saturday.

Pawel Biedziak, police spokesman in the North-western border city of Szczecin told PAP that the 98-percent pure alcohol, which was produced in Western Europe, had a market value of five million zlotys.
The alcohol was discovered by a special Polish police unit to combat organised crime after it received a tip from German special forces, Biedziak said.
He said the shipment crossed the Polish-German border at Kolbaskowo aboard three lorries, which drove to different regions of Poland.
PAP said the Polish treasury would lose some 2.5 million zlotys in customs duty inflows from the illegal import.
Further details were not given as the police was still investigating the case.
